ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a table, with three columns respectively being “plant species”, “N absorption per unit water body area (g/m²)”, and “P absorption per unit water body area (g/m²)”. The data in the table are: floating plant a has an N absorption amount of 22.30 and a P absorption amount of 1.70; floating plant b has an N absorption amount of 8.51 and a P absorption amount of 0.72; submerged plant c has an N absorption amount of 14.61 and a P absorption amount of 2.22. Then reason: The question requires introducing two plants to achieve the best effect of reducing N and P contents, so compare the total absorption amounts of pairwise combinations. The a+b combination has total N absorption of 22.30+8.51=30.81 and total P absorption of 1.70+0.72=2.42; the a+c combination has total N absorption of 22.30+14.61=36.91 and total P absorption of 1.70+2.22=3.92; the b+c combination has total N absorption of 8.51+14.61=23.12 and total P absorption of 0.72+2.22=2.94. Comparison shows that the a+c combination has the highest total absorption of both N and P, so a and c should be introduced.
